Isotrak Ltd.event: Acquired by AddSecure Group and subsequently integrated into Verilocation / Omegro Group.
Isotrak Ltd.evidence: Isotrak Ltd was an established vehicle tracking and fleet management software vendor headquartered in Northampton. According to corporate finance filings and registry records, the company was acquired by the AddSecure Group in 2020 and its operations are now managed as part of Verilocation / Omegro Group.

Yellow Line Parking Limited.evidence: Yellow Line Parking Ltd is an active UK company incorporated in 2013 that trades under the name AppyWay and operates the website appyway.com, as verified by Companies House and its privacy policy. The company provides a smart fleet parking application, AppyWay Pro, which helps commercial fleets optimize routing and operations.
